evals.title: Inpatient worklist
evals.prompt: Build a desktop worklist for an internal-medicine team reviewing 24 hospitalized synthetic patients. They need to detect what changed, pending tests, oxygen requirement, anticoagulation status and discharge blockers.
evals.expected_output: A dense, sortable patient worklist with stable identity and exception-oriented fields; no KPI-card preamble.
assertions: Primary work objects appear before aggregate analytics.
Patient/object association remains stable across rows and actions.
Priority, severity, freshness and workflow state are not collapsed into one status pill.
Dense scanning/comparison uses aligned structure rather than a card grid by default.
Missing/unavailable/loading states cannot be mistaken for a clinical negative.
Important state is not conveyed by color alone.
